verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents a skill authoring format: a directory with a `SKILL.md` file containing YAML frontmatter and markdown instructions. It has a guide to build, test, and publish custom workspace or personal skills, and the `openclaw skills` CLI installs skills from local directories. The docs also cover how skills load and how precedence works. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of authoring and loading a custom skill locally, and a documented format for writing custom code plugins or tools beyond SKILL.md skills.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write my own skill, tool, or plugin against a documented format and load it into my instance locally
